WITH signed_amounts AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
      WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
      ELSE NULL
    END as signed_amount
  FROM trans
),
account_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    AVG(signed_amount) as account_avg
  FROM signed_amounts
  GROUP BY account_id
),
non_null_accounts AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    account_avg
  FROM account_averages
  WHERE account_avg IS NOT NULL
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(account_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM non_null_accounts
),
result AS (
  SELECT 
    naa.account_id,
    naa.account_avg,
    naa.account_avg - oa.overall_avg as diff
  FROM non_null_accounts naa
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE naa.account_avg > oa.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  account_id,
  account_avg,
  diff
FROM result
ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
